claim_reviews.conclusion: “Permanent” with the sense “lasting indefinitely” is accurate.

response.rationale: Both answers fit the general sense “lasting indefinitely”: Indonesian permanen is standard, while Malaysian Malay kekal is the preferred formal/general equivalent. The relation is valid as a variety-preference contrast, though not an absolute exclusion: Malaysian Malay also records permanen as colloquial, and tetap overlaps in some contexts. No false-friend contrast is warranted.
